result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers suggest a wall printout for Thursday and short slides for the execs. A builds the exec version around 2–3 voted moments and ties each idea to its moment through the 'for [person] at [moment]' hypothesis format, then ends with a specific decision. B puts pain points and ideas on separate slides, so the ideas are less clearly tied to the moments they fix. A goes a bit beyond presentation advice by questioning the emotion line. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers use a different format for each audience. B fits the exec rubric more closely: it builds the slides around 2–3 voted moments, ties each idea to the moment it fixes through hypotheses, says to leave out the 11 pain points and 9 ideas, and ends with a specific decision. A is more practical and doesn't change the map, but its exec slides list pain points and ideas separately instead of pairing each idea with its moment. B also loses points for reworking the map itself (renaming stages, questioning the emotion line).
